title: Pseudo-Clementine Letter of Peter to James
historical_status: Historical early-Christian literature; not an attribution of genuine authorship to Peter or Clement, and not additional canonical Scripture.

rights.scope: Imported XML and normalized Greek sections; not relicensed under the repository's CC BY 4.0 license.
rights.attribution: Open Greek and Latin / First1KGreek; Albert Schwegler (1847 edition). Full contributors, funding, proofreading, conversion, and revision credits retained in the TEI header.
rights.changes: XML unchanged; sections.json extracts headings/prose with normalized whitespace and preserves CTS references. Page-break metadata retained separately. No spelling corrections or gap filling.

coverage.note: Coverage is of the supplied 1847 edition file, not a claim of manuscript collation or philological accuracy. Never generate missing Greek or English to fill this source gap.

translation_policy.draft_basis: Greek source text, not an existing English translation
required_review_evidence: source XML SHA-256 and exact CTS passage reference
normalized Greek passage SHA-256 and English draft SHA-256
generator model, prompt hash and generation timestamp
separate source-comparison pass with reviewer identity, method and timestamp
clause-by-clause coverage, lexical decisions, additions and omissions checked
unresolved issues, source defects and proposed corrections explicitly recorded
accepted verdict bound to the current source and translation hashes
output rights and attribution reviewed before CC BY-only reader export
translation_policy.publication: blocked; source registration and structural checks are not translation approval
